jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Primary Function
The Senior Specialist, Commercial Excellence & Business Operations plays a critical role in enabling data-driven decision making and operational excellence across the Japan Electrophysiology (EP) business.
This position serves as a strategic business partner to commercial leadership by transforming complex data into actionable insights, supporting business planning and performance management, and driving initiatives that improve commercial effectiveness and organizational productivity. In addition to commercial analytics responsibilities, the role contributes to distributor management, business process improvement, and digital transformation initiatives that strengthen operational capabilities and support sustainable business growth.
The successful candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with business acumen, financial understanding, project management skills, and a continuous improvement mindset.The successful candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with business acumen, financial understanding, project management skills, and a continuous improvement mindset.
Major Responsibilities
Commercial Data Management & Analytics: Serve as the primary owner of commercial data management and analytical support for the Japan EP business.
    Manage and continuously improve commercial data infrastructure, reporting processes, and analytical frameworks.
    Consolidate, validate, and maintain multiple data sources.
    Ensure integrity, accuracy, consistency, and governance of commercial data utilized for business decision-making.
    Define, maintain, and standardize commercial KPIs across the organization.
    Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and performance monitoring tools utilizing Excel, Power BI, and other reporting platforms.
    Conduct regular and ad hoc analyses to identify Growth opportunities, Market trends, and Commercial risks
    Translate analytical findings into actionable recommendations for business leaders.
    Provide timely and insightful performance analysis to support commercial reviews and management decision-making.
    Collaborate with regional and global stakeholders regarding reporting and analytics initiatives.
Business Planning & Commercial Performance Management: Support commercial leadership in planning, forecasting, and performance management activities.
    Support annual operating plan development and periodic business reviews.
    Assist in forecasting processes through analytical modeling and performance tracking.
    Conduct business performance analyses and identify key drivers impacting results.
    Support resource allocation, territory optimization, and investment prioritization discussions.
    Develop presentations and recommendations for leadership reviews.
    Partner with Finance and Commercial leadership to evaluate business opportunities and risks.
    Support development of business cases for strategic initiatives and commercial investments.
Dealer & Channel Performance Management: Support effective distributor and dealer management through analytical and operational excellence.
    Monitor and evaluate distributor performance using data-driven methodologies.
    Develop and maintain dealer performance scorecards and reporting tools.
    Support planning and execution of dealer incentive programs.
    Conduct analyses to identify opportunities for channel optimization and market coverage improvement.
    Coordinate dealer-related reviews, governance processes, and business meetings.
    Support contract administration and distributor compliance activities.
    Assist in third-party risk assessment processes and distributor evaluations.
    Collaborate with Sales leadership to improve distributor engagement and execution effectiveness.
Business Process Excellence & Digital Transformation: Drive operational excellence by optimizing business processes, leveraging digital solutions, and enabling scalable ways of working across the Japan EP organization.
    Identify and improve inefficient processes across commercial and support functions.
    Simplify, standardize, and automate business workflows to enhance productivity and scalability.
    Partner with IT and business stakeholders to implement digital solutions and system enhancements.
    Support adoption of new technologies, reporting tools, and digital capabilities.
    Promote data accessibility, self-service reporting, and automation opportunities.
    Establish process KPIs and monitor performance to drive continuous improvement.
    Lead or support cross-functional initiatives that improve operational effectiveness and business efficiency.
Minimum Requirements
Education:
A bachelor’s degree or equivalent. Associate Degree will be accepted with relevant experience and certifications in the the field of data management and analysis.
Background:
    3+ years’ experience in Commercial data management and system structure with analysis in commercial organization, preferably healthcare industry.
    Sales Database knowledge and experiences required, Excel, PowerBI skills are plus
    Successful experiences of project management in commercial data initiatives
    Successful experience of stake holder management in matrix organization
Preferred Requirement
    3+ years' experience in Commercial Excellence, Sales Force Effectiveness (SFE), Business Analytics, Sales, or Marketing within the medical device or pharmaceutical industry.
    3+ years' experience in management consulting, business planning, or strategic project roles, preferably within healthcare-related industries.
    Experience leading or supporting business process improvement (BPR), digital transformation, automation, or operational excellence initiatives across cross-functional organizations.

jobs.title: Director of Global Strategy & Insights
jobs.location: United States > Austin : 8701 Bee Caves Rd
jobs.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.
JOB DESCRIPTION:
The Opportunity
Abbott seeks a Global Strategy and Insights Director for its Cardiac Rhythm Management Global Marketing team. This integral leader will be responsible for establishing and leading a global strategy and insights function and play a critical role in shaping strategic direction, identifying growth opportunities, and driving short-term and long-term goals for a billion-dollar, global business.

This Director will bring clarity to our global markets, our market share in different countries and regions, and help track our competition's development. This experience leader will lead the team that drives our market research efforts and gathers all third-party data to help the global commercial teams better understand market trends.

As part of the executive leadership team, this Director will help develop our strategy for short and long-term growth, while being involved in organic and inorganic market growth options. Finally, this Director will help drive strategic plans and tactically execute the key insights this team delivers.

Location: Austin, TX or Sylmar, CA

What You’ll Work On
- People Management: Lead the Global Strategy and Insights organization within the Cardiac Rhythm Management business unit, including setting goals, defining priorities, hiring talent, championing customer-centric culture, cross-function and cross-region collaboration, building capabilities, and managing budget and operations to achieve business results.

- Product Management: Initial analysis and on-going product management of long-tail lateral flow product lines, including kill/cure/continue (lifecycle management) recommendations.

- Strategic & Business Planning: Provide strategic leadership, planning, and direction to the organization to drive growth and profitability through annual strategic planning and ongoing strategic initiatives; guide franchise and functional plan, ensuring the alignment with BU strategy.

- Identify market opportunities that can differentiate the business from competition and enable profitable growth; drive portfolio optimization of both new and existing products.

- Market Modeling & Forecasting: Build a consistent fact base of market size, share and growth across franchises and regions in the Abbott ID business; drive cross-functional alignment and form the “single source of truth” for OEM, LBE, NPI and business assessments.

- Market Intelligence: Assess customer needs, conduct competitive analysis, and identify enabling products, technologies, and business levers to optimize performance and enable revenue and margin growth.

- Market Research: Capture customer insights and articulate market landscape, such as unmet needs to refine value proposition, pricing elasticity to drive commercialization, and ethnography to identify drivers and barriers for new product adoption; manage complex, large, or difficult data analytics and research projects.

- Select and manage ongoing relationships with external research agencies and consultants to ensure the organization receives satisfactory service standards; develop and manage contracting for data and market research.

- Competitive Intelligence: Strengthen Abbott competitive positioning by capturing industry trends, stakeholder dynamics, and competitor activities in a timely and action-oriented manner, such as scenario planning (war gaming), weekly market surveillance, industry conference intelligence, and deep dive on competitors, products and critical events.

- Partner cross-functionally with key stakeholders in Finance, Marketing, and Commercial Excellence.

Experience You'll Bring
Required Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in finance, business administration or related field.

- Minimum of 12 years’ work experience.

- Five (5) or more years of forecasting, planning, project management and team management experience.

- Demonstrated market intelligence knowledge, skills and techniques and sales forecasting experience.

- Experience with advanced forecasting techniques, such as regression analysis, cluster analysis, conjoint analysis and discrete choice modeling.

- Strong knowledge and capability in mathematics, statistics and computer skills related to modeling.

- Experience interfacing effectively both domestically and internationally.

- Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent oral and written communication skills.

- Experience interacting effectively with senior management and partnering with others in a matrixed environment.

Preferred Qualifications
- Master's degree (± 18 years) MBA preferred due to the position’s heavy involvement in solving business problems throughout the division, and broad-based understanding of business operations and current market environment is critical to effective performance.

- Management consulting or healthcare strategy experience preferred

- Global experience in a finance or planning capacity preferred.

What We Offer
At Abbott, you can have a good job that can grow into a great career. We offer:
- Training and career development , with onboarding programs for new employees and tuition assistance

- Financial security through competitive compensation, incentives and retirement plans

- Health care and well-being programs including medical, dental, vision, wellness and occupational health programs

- Paid time off

- 401(k) retirement savings with a generous company match

- The stability of a company with a record of strong financial performance and history of being actively involved in local communities

The base pay for this position is
$149,300.00 – $298,700.00 In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

The Director of Strategy and Portfolio Management is a key leadership role focused on shaping and driving the strategic direction of the company’s product portfolio in North America. This role is vital in ensuring that the company’s product portfolio is strategically positioned for sustained growth and competitive advantage, aligning all functions to drive the company’s long-term vision and business success.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Strategic Planning:
Lead the formulation and execution of the Strategic plan, ensuring alignment with the company’s overarching business objectives and market opportunities.
- Tactical Strategy Implementation:
Lead the tactical/execution Plan process across all relevant functions, ensuring that departmental efforts are aligned and contribute to the overall strategic goals.
- Portfolio Strategy Management:
Manage the product portfolio’s lifecycle, from strategic planning of new product introductions to the phase-out of end-of-life products, ensuring that all decisions are aligned and contribute to market leadership.
- Cross-Functional Alignment: - Drive collaboration across functions (Marketing, Sales, and Market Access) to ensure all strategic initiatives are integrated across the organization, including scenario planning, competitive analysis, and risk mitigation.
- Leads monthly CMR (Commercial management review) meetings to ensure cross functional alignment regarding portfolio launches and strategic initiatives.

- Scenario Planning & Strategic Risk Management:
Lead scenario planning efforts and identify strategic risks, developing mitigation strategies to ensure portfolio decisions are resilient and forward-looking.
- Ad-Hoc strategic initiatives: lead and manage unique, high impact projects that arise outside of regular portfolio planning cycles, ensuring that these one-off initiatives are aligns to overall business.
- Commercial Understanding: - Demonstrate an understanding of business drivers and influence them to achieve flawless execution.
- Understand customer needs and operations.
- Incorporate consumer and customer insights and trends into strategy and tactics.

- Commercial Leadership: Act as a consultant to Sales, Market access and Marketing Directors on appropriate commercial strategies. Serve as the lead with the Global PMO team on commercial portfolio strategies.
- Building and Leading Teams: - Promote cross-functional understanding between Sales, Marketing, and market access teams. Achieve results through effective team leadership rather than individual effort.
- Demonstrate a record of successful talent development through direct or indirect reporting relationships. Proactively manage talent and create development opportunities.

Education / Experience
- BS or BA required; MBA strongly preferred due to the business complexity and P&L support of the position.
- Sustained experience and proven results in the following areas: appr. 8-10 years of experience and successful track record in marketing, commercial functions, ideally in the health care arena and managing a P&L
- Leading of successful commercial teams, several years of people management experience
- Proven track record of developing successful commercial strategies, tactics, including implementation

- Strong analytical ability and understanding.

jobs.title: FP&A Manager - FAC
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
About Abbott
Abbott is a global healthcare company committed to helping people live not just longer, but better. We employ around over 100,000 people in 150+ countries with a diverse portfolio spanning pharmaceuticals, nutrition, diagnostics and devices.
At Abbott, you have the opportunity to make a positive impact on the world through challenging and rewarding work as part of a highly successful and trusted organization that is shaping the future of health. Realize your potential!

Role Purpose
The FP&A Manager is responsible for driving the company’s financial performance by leading   financial planning ,   budgeting ,   forecasting , and   performance analysis . The role partners with senior management and business teams to support strategic decision‑making through high‑quality financial insights.

Key Responsibilities
Financial Planning   &   Forecasting
- Lead the   annual budget, rolling forecast, and long‑term   financial planning   processes
- Develop and maintain robust financial models (P&L, cash flow, CAPEX)
- Ensure alignment between financial plans and business strategy

Financial Analysis   & Performance Management
- Analyze   actual vs. budget/forecast variances   and explain key drivers
- Identify risks, opportunities, and performance improvement levers
- Deliver ad‑hoc financial analyses to support strategic initiatives

Reporting & Financial Communication
- Prepare   monthly, quarterly, and annual management reports
- Develop clear dashboards with financial and operational KPIs
- Present financial results, insights, and recommendations to senior management

Business Partnering

Data Science

- Interpret data trends and present data-driven strategic insights and actionable recommendations to senior leadership related to business performance, operations, and customer insights
- Formulate analytical strategies for proactively addressing customer needs, solving business problems, achieving commercial and marketing objectives, and developing new business opportunities

Teamwork and Collaboration:
- Partner with internal (e.g., commercial, marketing, and finance) and external (e.g., vendors & agencies) stakeholders to align on business objectives, expectations, timelines, and action plan
- Effectively communicate and actively collaborate within and beyond the team to cultivate teamwork and empowered partnerships
- Create an open environment built on trust, candor, and co-elevation principles
- Take accountability and offer help and support to colleagues

Required
- Bachelors Degree In a Related field or an equivalent combination of education and work experience
- Minimum 9 years of related work experience.
- 5+ years experience in commercial or market analytics desired, preferably in the healthcare industry in a market science or business analytics role.

- Strong hands-on experience and expertise in one or more big data technologies, i.e., Hadoop, Spark, H20.ai, cloud AI platforms, containerization

- Experience utilizing big data sets with medical claims and/or longitudinal patient-level information
- Proven ability to manage multiple tasks concurrently under aggressive timelines in a dynamic and ambiguous environment
- Strong strategic thinking, executive presence capabilities, and attention to detail
- Advanced communication and presentation skills including ability to create impactful power point presentations with visual storytelling and adjust the story/details based on the audience
- Deep understanding of latest analytical tools and dashboarding technologies, data warehousing, software, process, and applications (e.g., SQL, Tableau, AWS, Python, Machine Learning, Predictive Analytics, etc.)

Preferred

Abbott es líder mundial en cuidado de la salud, que crea ciencia innovadora para mejorar la salud de las personas.  Siempre estamos mirando hacia el futuro, anticipando cambios en la ciencia y la tecnología médica.

Esta posición está ubicada en la Ciudad de México en la División de nutrición. Millones de personas en todo el mundo cuentan con nuestras marcas líderes, incluidas Similac®, PediaSure®, Pedialyte®, Ensure®, Glucerna® y ZonePerfect®, para ayudar a obtener los nutrientes que necesitan para vivir su vida más saludable.

- Operar y dar soporte a modelos de forecasting comercial en coordinación con Finanzas y áreas comerciales.
- Integrar y asegurar la correcta gestión de fuentes de información internas y externas (market audits, sell‑in, sell‑out).
- Desarrollar soluciones analíticas y dashboards que soporten la ejecución del negocio para México y Puerto Rico.
- Coordinar iniciativas de automatización, gobierno de datos y mejora continua en BI alineadas con los estándares del COE regional.

Que harás:

- Gestión del tracking de las principales variables de negocio para México y el cluster México–Puerto Rico.
- Análisis integral de ventas, market share y desempeño competitivo, generando alertas y recomendaciones para la toma de decisiones.
- Desarrollo de análisis de crecimiento, performance y drivers del negocio a nivel país y cluster.
- Traducción de análisis en insights claros y accionables para Dirección General y stakeholders regionales.
- Soporte a procesos formales de forecasting (RLBE), incluyendo documentación de supuestos y alineación con Finanzas.
- Gestión y coordinación de market audits y estudios de mercado locales y regionales, incluyendo fuentes de Puerto Rico.
- Aseguramiento de la calidad de datos, reconciliaciones y seguimiento con proveedores externos.
- Aplicación de lineamientos de estandarización, KPI dictionary y gobierno de datos definidos por el COE LATAM.

Cualificaciones requeridas
- Carreras de Ingeniería, Economía, Estadística, Data Science o afines.
- Inglés avanzado
- Experiencia de 3 a 5 años en Business Intelligence, Analytics o áreas similares.
- Experiencia en análisis comercial, market audits y reporting ejecutivo. Interacción con áreas financieras y comerciales.
- Experiencia trabajando en entornos regionales o modelos de servicios compartidos es deseable.
- Capacidad de estructurar información compleja y convertirla en insights accionables.

- Conocimientos de Power BI, Power Query y modelado de datos.
- Conocimientos de automatización y programación básica son un valor agregado.
- Experiencia en la industria de la salud, deseable.

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
ABOUT ABBOTT
Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

WORKING AT ABBOTT
At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You will have access to:
- Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Working Location: Me Linh Point Tower, Ho Chi Minh City
Report to: General Manager, Core Diagnostics

1. Responsible for Medical Marketing of all products supplied by CRDx to the Vietnam and Cambodia markets.
2. Work closely with the Commercial team, ensure appropriate assay implementation, scientific positioning, and performance accuracy to achieve Value Expansion and New Account Acquisition.
3. Collaborate closely with Application Specialists to:
- Drive effective assay implementation and optimization at customer sites
- Support scientific interpretation and resolution of assay discrepancies
- Strengthen customer confidence and enable assay share capture and menu expansion

4. Act as the medical authority and strategic partner, ensuring compliant, on‑label use of assays while enabling sustainable business growth and customer confidence.
5. Drive Strategic Marketing and Product Lifecycle Management, including:
- Go‑to‑Market strategy
- Product portfolio management
- Competitive intelligence and differentiation

6. Work closely with Area and Global Marketing and Medical teams to adapt and deploy global strategies, medical direction, and initiatives to the local market, ensuring effective execution and achievement of local commercial objectives.

Core Job Responsibilities:
Medical & Scientific Leadership:
- Drive the medical and scientific aspects of assigned assays strictly within approved market indications (on‑label use), ensuring compliance with regulatory, ethical, and company standards.
- Serve as the scientific and medical authority for assigned products, disease areas, and clinical applications.
- Demonstrate strong understanding of disease areas, diagnostic algorithms, and clinical pathways, translating these into clear medical and scientific propositions.
- Monitor and interpret clinical guidelines, scientific literature, real‑world evidence, and competitive medical data to provide actionable strategic insights.

Medical Marketing & Assay Differentiation:
- Develop and execute medical marketing strategies that enable assay differentiation, evidence‑based positioning, and lifecycle optimization.
- Translate complex clinical and scientific data into clear, compliant, and impactful medical messages to support marketing and sales effectiveness.
- Support assay positioning in result discrepancy cases and complex clinical scenarios through sound scientific interpretation and risk mitigation.
- Monitor new products launching, promotional items and products transition or   discontinuation plans (phase-in/phase-out)

Product Marketing Leadership (Chemistry & Immunoassay)
- Lead and develop a team of marketing responsible for product marketing and lifecycle management of Clinical Chemistry and Immunoassay portfolios.
- Provide strategic direction, coaching, and performance management to ensure strong product positioning, effective launches, and continuous portfolio growth.
- Guide Product Managers in developing medical‑driven marketing strategies, including segmentation, targeting, scientific messaging, and differentiation.
- Oversee product planning activities, including portfolio prioritization, launch readiness, lifecycle optimization, and phase‑out management.

KOL & Medical Engagement:
- Build and maintain strong relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), clinicians, laboratory directors, and professional societies.
- Lead and support medical education activities, including scientific meetings, advisory boards, workshops, congresses, and internal training programs.

Commercial & Tender Support
- Support commercial and tender activities by responding to medical and scientific inquiries, providing clinical evaluations, and addressing scientific objections within approved indications.
- Enable effective commercial execution by aligning scientific value, clinical relevance, and customer needs.

Medical Governance & Risk Management
- Act as the medical lead in managing product‑related medical inquiries, complaints, laboratory result discrepancies, and clinical concerns, ensuring patient safety and appropriate risk management.
- Collaborate cross‑functionally with Service, Application, QA, Regulatory, and Commercial teams to support medical investigations, complaint handling, and corrective actions.

Cross‑Functional Leadership & Capability Building
- Work closely with Marketing, Sales, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, and Market Access teams to ensure consistent, compliant scientific messaging.
- Contribute to capability building by coaching and guiding teams on medical excellence, scientific communication, and ethical promotion.

MINIMUM BACKGROUND/ EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

Qualifications/Experience:

- 8–12+ years of experience in Medical Marketing, Medical Affairs, Diagnostics, MedTech
- Strong experience in:

- - Diagnostics assays (preferably Chemistry & Immunoassay)

- - Clinical interpretation and discrepancy management

- - Strategic marketing and product lifecycle management

- - Cross‑functional and people leadership

- Solid understanding of diseases area, immunoassay, testing algorithm
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Competencies (Knowledge, Skills, Abilities & Personal Characteristics):
- Deep knowledge of Laboratory Medicine, Clinical Pathology, and Diagnostic Assays, particularly in Clinical Chemistry and Immunoassay.
- Strong understanding of disease areas, diagnostic algorithms, and clinical pathways relevant to core diagnostics.
- Solid knowledge of clinical guidelines, scientific literature, and real‑world evidence, with the ability to translate data into medical and commercial insights.
- Thorough understanding of regulatory, compliance, and ethical requirements, including on‑label promotion and medical governance in diagnostics.
- Strong awareness of competitive landscape, assay technologies, and market trends in Vietnam and Cambodia.
- Ability to translate complex scientific and clinical data into clear, compliant, and impactful medical marketing messages.
- Strong strategic thinking and analytical skills to drive assay differentiation, portfolio optimization, and lifecycle management.
- Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, particularly with KOLs, clinicians, laboratory directors, and internal functions.
- High standards of scientific integrity, ethics, and accountability.

MINIMUM EDUCATION REQUIRED

- Medical Doctor (MD/MBBS) or PhD in Laboratory Medicine / Clinical Pathology / Diagnostics or related laboratory disciplines, with a strong background in medical diagnostics (mandatory).

Role Purpose:

The Brand Manager – Biologics & Biosimilars is responsible for developing and executing the commercial strategy for the biologics and biosimilars portfolio in Pakistan, with a key focus on oncology and specialty care.

The role will lead brand planning, market development, launch readiness, stakeholder engagement, and in-market execution while working closely with Sales, Medical, Regulatory, Market Access, Supply Chain, and Finance. The Brand Manager will play an important role in driving awareness, differentiation, adoption, and sustainable growth of biologic and biosimilar brands in a competitive and evolving market.

Key Responsibilities:

- Develop and execute annual brand strategies and tactical plans for the biologics and biosimilars portfolio.
- Define brand positioning, value propositions, customer segmentation, targeting, key messages, and performance objectives.
- Lead market development initiatives for originator biologics and biosimilars, with a strong focus on oncology and specialty-care markets.
- Assess market dynamics, treatment pathways, competitor activity, customer needs, access barriers, pricing trends, and opportunities for portfolio growth.
- Lead commercial launch planning and launch readiness for new biologic and biosimilar products.
- Coordinate cross-functional launch activities across Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, Market Access, Supply Chain, and Finance.

- Develop and implement promotional campaigns, scientific-commercial communication, and customer engagement initiatives in line with local regulations and company compliance standards.
- Monitor brand performance, market share, customer adoption, competitive developments, and execution effectiveness.
- Translate market insights and customer feedback into actionable brand strategies and commercial initiatives.
- Support forecasting, demand planning, budgeting, performance tracking, and business reviews for the biologics and biosimilars portfolio.
- Partner with regional and global teams to adapt broader biologics and biosimilars strategies to the Pakistan market.
- Drive strong cross-functional alignment and ensure effective execution of agreed brand priorities.

Qualifications & Experience:

- Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related discipline.
- MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred.
- 3–5 years of experience in pharmaceutical marketing, brand management, or a related commercial role.
- Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in oncology is required.
- Experience with originator biologics and/or biosimilars is highly preferred.
- Experience in specialty-care marketing, product launches, market development, or lifecycle management is an advantage.
- Strong understanding of oncology customers, treatment pathways, healthcare stakeholders, and market dynamics.
- Good understanding of the Pakistan pharmaceutical and healthcare environment, including institutional business, procurement, access, and reimbursement dynamics.
- Experience in competitive analysis, market research, customer insights, forecasting, and commercial planning.

Key Competencies:

- Strong strategic marketing and brand-management capabilities.
- Ability to translate business strategy into focused and measurable execution plans.
- Strong analytical, commercial, and financial acumen.
- Excellent stakeholder-management and cross-functional leadership skills.
- Strong communication, presentation, and influencing capabilities.
- Ability to understand and communicate the clinical and commercial value of biologic and biosimilar therapies.
- Strong customer orientation and understanding of oncology and specialty-care markets.
- High level of ownership, accountability, agility, and execution discipline.
- Ability to operate effectively in a complex, competitive, and rapidly evolving market environment.

Languages:

- Fluent English required.

Travel:
- Regular domestic travel may be required to support customer engagement, field execution, key accounts, and business priorities.

Therapeutic & Portfolio Focus:

- The role will primarily support the biologics and biosimilars portfolio, with a strong focus on oncology and specialty care. The Brand Manager will be expected to build effective strategies for both originator biologics and biosimilars, supporting successful launches, market development, stakeholder engagement, access, adoption, and long-term brand growth.

jobs.title: Director, Marketing
jobs.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.
JOB DESCRIPTION:
WORKING AT ABBOTT:
At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:
- Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of
- Free medical coverage for employees* via the Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO
- An excellent retirement savings plan with high employer contribution
- Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree
- A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune
- A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists

The Opportunity
Abbott's Rapid & Molecular Diagnostics (RMDx) business is seeking a strategic and results-driven Director, Marketing to lead the Marketing function supporting the Toxicology, Workplace & eScreen portfolio.

This role represents a significant investment in accelerating business growth and market leadership by creating dedicated Marketing capabilities. The Director will establish the strategic marketing vision, drive business performance, optimize portfolio growth, and build a high-performing team focused on advancing both product and service offerings.

The successful candidate will serve as a key member of the Toxicology, Workplace & eScreen leadership team and have strong understanding of SaaS, platform-based solutions, and digital customer engagement strategies. In addition, this leader will partner extensively across Commercial Operations, Product Management, Digital Solutions (IT), Medical/Scientific Affairs, Finance, Client Success, and Enterprise Marketing functions to deliver sustainable growth and market differentiation.

This Director will oversee marketing strategies for a diverse portfolio that includes workplace drug testing products, laboratory-based toxicology services, occupational health solutions, and eScreen digital platform capabilities.

What You'll Do
Strategic Marketing Leadership
- Develop and execute an integrated marketing strategy aligned with divisional growth objectives and long-term business plans.
- Lead market segmentation, customer targeting, value proposition development, and portfolio positioning strategies.
- Establish clear go-to-market strategies across employer, healthcare, laboratory, occupational health, government, and channel partner segments.
- Translate market insights into actionable growth initiatives that increase revenue, profitability, and market share.
- Serve as primary marketing advisor to the DVP and divisional leadership team.

Portfolio & Business Growth
- Drive growth across both recurring service revenue streams and product-based offerings.
- Evaluate portfolio performance and identify expansion opportunities through new solutions, adjacent markets, strategic partnerships, and customer innovation.
- Partner closely with Product Management to prioritize investments and commercial opportunities.
- Develop lifecycle management strategies that maximize customer adoption, retention, and utilization.
- Lead pricing, value communication, competitive positioning, and commercialization initiatives.

Customer & Market Insights
- Establish robust voice-of-customer programs to generate meaningful customer insights.
- Monitor competitive dynamics, industry trends, market intelligence, and emerging customer needs.
- Utilize data analytics to evaluate market opportunities and optimize marketing investments.
- Translate customer and market insights into actionable business recommendations.

Demand Generation & Commercial Excellence
- Lead integrated marketing campaigns designed to accelerate lead generation, customer acquisition, and revenue growth.
- Partner with Sales leadership to improve customer engagement, sales effectiveness, and commercial execution.
- Develop messaging and content strategies supporting customer education and market awareness.
- Ensure alignment between marketing initiatives and field execution.

Organizational Development
- Build and lead a dedicated Marketing organization supporting Toxicology, Workplace & eScreen.
- Establish organizational structure, capabilities, processes, and governance to support future growth.
- Develop talent strategies that attract, retain, and grow high-performing marketing professionals.
- Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and customer-centricity.

Cross-Functional Leadership
- Partner with Commercial, Finance, Operations, Digital Product (IT) teams, BHR, Legal, Regulatory, Quality, and Compliance functions.
- Lead marketing representation in strategic planning, operating reviews, and leadership forums.
- Influence enterprise-wide initiatives that impact customer experience and business growth.
- Ensure all marketing activities comply with Abbott policies and applicable regulatory requirements.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree required.
- Master’s degree in marketing, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or related field preferred.
- 10+ years of progressive commercial, marketing, product management, or business leadership experience.
- 5+ years of people leadership experience managing managers and/or professional teams.
- Proven experience developing and executing enterprise-level marketing strategies.
- Demonstrated success leading business growth initiatives and portfolio expansion.
- Strong financial and business acumen with experience managing budgets and investment priorities.
- Experience influencing senior leaders and driving cross-functional alignment.
- Exceptional communication, executive presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience within diagnostics, laboratory services, toxicology, occupational health, healthcare technology, digital health, healthcare services, or related industries.
- Experience supporting both product and service-based business models.
- Strong understanding of SaaS, platform-based solutions, and digital customer engagement strategies.
- Experience leading organizational transformation or building new capabilities within an established business.
- Knowledge of workforce health, workplace testing, compliance screening, and occupational health markets.
- Experience working within highly regulated healthcare environments.

Leadership Expectations
The Director, Marketing will be expected to operate as a transformational leader who can successfully establish and scale a dedicated Marketing function while driving alignment across Commercial, Product, Operations, and Corporate stakeholders. This individual must balance strategic vision with operational execution, ensuring marketing investments directly contribute to business performance, customer value creation, and long-term growth.

The role requires a leader capable of shaping the future growth strategy for the Toxicology, Workplace & eScreen business while positioning Abbott as the trusted partner of choice in workplace health, toxicology, and digital screening solutions.

- Deliver results with integrity and accountability.

- Develop people and build high-performing teams.
- Put customers and patients at the center of every decision.

- 帶領北二區業務團隊達成區域業績、市佔率與品牌目標，透過卓越執行力、客戶影響力及團隊績效管理，持續創造商業成果
- 輔導業務代表制定並執行區域發展計畫，整合品牌策略、HCP客戶分群、市場動態、資源配置與團隊能力發展，推動區域業務持續成長。
- 善用市場洞察、CRM數據及業務分析工具，掌握趨勢與商機，支持區域策略制定與關鍵決策。
- 確保前線執行具備即時性與精準度，有效推動品牌活動、新產品上市及全通路客戶互動策略落實。
- 在關鍵客戶經營、KOL合作、新品上市及重大商業議題中展現領導力，建立客戶信任並推動策略性合作。
- 透過高品質的同行拜訪、績效回饋及人才發展計畫，提升業務團隊的策略思維、客戶影響力與銷售效能。創造結構化的回饋節奏，在有難度的溝通中表現出勇氣，以同理心領導，鞏固團隊的信任與承諾。
- 與行銷、醫藥學術、及其他跨功能團隊密切合作，共同推動業務成果。
- 發揮主人翁精神，在快速變動的市場環境中帶領團隊面對挑戰與不確定性，做出具商業價值的決策與資源取捨。
- 確保所有商業活動符合公司政策、產業法規及推廣合規要求，並建立以誠信與道德為核心的團隊文化。

Skills & Experience Required:*
- 大學畢業，營養保健學相關背景尤佳。
- 7年以上經驗消費性健康照護或營養品領域的經驗，並與多類型的醫療專業人士（HCP）互動，包括至少2 年成功的銷售監督/管理經驗
- 有招標合約管理、KOL管理經驗
- 詳細了解支撐醫藥市場的商業原則。
- 良好的溝通、分析和談判能力。
- 本職務需具備開車能力並持有有效汽車駕照。

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You will have access to:
- Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of .

- Amazing health and wellness benefits and perks.

- A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune 500.

- A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

As a global leader in Cardiac Rhythm Technologies, we focus on innovative technologies that can improve the way doctors treat people with heart arrhythmias, or irregular heartbeats.

This role is responsible for providing the allocated sales team with the leadership, direction and resources to ensure sales targets are achieved and to liaise with Head of Sales and Marketing as appropriate to ensure short-and long-term sales strategies are executed by the team. This role will cover South Brisbane and Goldcoast

Responsibilities:
- Direct the activities of the state sales team for the achievement of short- and long-term business objectives, increased profit and market share within the state-based CRM portfolio.

- In consultation with the Head of Sales, translate sales - data/analysis into day to day working sales and marketing strategies and driving these through the sales force.

- Maintain regular contact with identified Key Opinion Leaders within the state to increase CRM brand.

- Actively seek, identify, analyse, and present new business opportunities and improvement ideas to Regional Sales Manager on an ongoing basis.

- In conjunction with Head of Sales and field staff negotiate major deals and ensure tenders are managed with customers and other stakeholders.

- Manage the state sales team e.g., recruitment, retention, development plans, succession planning, training etc.

- Ensure that local expense budgets are managed in consultation with Head of Sales.

- Review and approve sales employees' expenses in accordance with financial and Abbott policies.

- You may be required to work outside of your ordinary hours of work to participate in essential training, team meetings, customer events or trade shows/conferences. These events may take place on an evening and/or weekend.

- People Management and Development- Lead, develop and manage an effective, engaged and motivated team.

Certification

It is a requirement of your role that obtain and maintain certification as specified by Abbott.

Qualifications:

Essential

•         Tertiary Qualification in a Science, Biomedical, Medical Science, Business Management or related fields essential.

•         Comprehensive Cardiovascular medical device Industry Knowledge.

•         Proven track record in delivering sales targets in a complex, solution selling environment.

•         Ability to manage a sales territory and lead a sales and technical team.

•         Good understanding of the medical/healthcare industry process and function; able to convincingly discuss this with customers, as well as internal and external experts.

•         Previous experience working in the medical devices, healthcare or pharmaceutical industry in a sales management role

jobs.title: Sr. Regional Sales Manager
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Job Description

1.Primary Job Function
负责所分配区域内的销售业绩达成，包括但不限于赢得新业务机会、维护现有客户并提升雅培份额，合同成功续约，长期锁定与客户的合作关系。
·对所负责销售区域的销售达成和份额增长负全责；
·制定所负责区域可落地执行的业务计划包含经销商计划，持续提升生意体量；
·对所负责区域的现有生意保护、潜在生意丢失管理，潜在机会开发等有清晰计划和对应的落地方案；
·建立有强烈成功意愿的高绩效销售团队和人才梯队。

2.Core Job Responsibilities
绩效达成
·按月/季度针对不同客户和销售情况分解规划指标，进行销售预估并如期执行，管理达成；
·完成每月辖区IMS/TMS指标，以及承诺的关单目标；
·通过数据分析，准确预估业务走向/机会，进行业务新机会判定，解决问题并完成预估；
·对团队进行有效的销售辅导，关注销售团队的平衡绩效；
·有效识别业务风险，并提出有效解决方案化解风险。
区域业务规划
·根据公司战略重点，进行省级/经销商策略规划和销售区域划分，通过价格谈判，客户投入，产品分析，制定有针对性的销售策略；
·关注重点客户，通过合理的指标分解，制定达成指标的具体方案；
·根据市场环境变化合理更新区域策略的落地和执行。
市场洞察
·收集所在区域的行业政策变化、关注市场动态、竞争对手动态，提取关键因素，形成分析预测，主动评估和应对政策影响，平衡机会与风险；
·了解现有客户情况，洞察关键客户群体（医院、LHCP）在学术和医院管理方面的潜在需求和变化，判断客户关机决策依据，辅助客户长期发展；
·关注竞品区域动向，预判潜在风险，并作出反应，整合有可能的机会和增长点；
·通过掌握不同渠道的信息，包括但不限于关键现有及目标客户渠道以及竞品渠道，建立完善的渠道网络。
渠道管理
·根据区域及省区的业务规划进行经销商布局；
·关注经销商的经营动态和业绩达成，根据情况选用育留；
·管理和协调经销商库存，营运情况，以及返利等政策申请；
·配合渠道管理部门进行经销商培训，品牌推介，授权风险评估。
关键客户管理
·明确区域内重点客户以及重点客户销售目标，含现有客户和目标客户；收集并及时更新现有客户及目标客户的数据，保持完整性和准确性，包括但不限于客户关键决策人信息、产品使用情况的趋势和潜在需求、在学术和医院管理方面的潜在需求和变化等；
·现有重点客户管理包含但不限于满意度管理，风险管理以及机会管理：
·掌握重点目标客户检验科室的仪器、试剂、开单科室情况，收集竞品信息以及渠道经销商等信息；挖掘客户需求，了解客户痛点，制定区域内关键客户中长期发展计划；
·推进系统的学术合作，规划和管理区域专家网络，建立客户生态圈。
人才发展与团队建设
·指导销售工作，衡量指标并转化为可执行计划，带领团队达成目标和持续提升；
·通过高质量的招聘、培训和发展，提供持续的指导，通过激励与认可留住优秀人才，培养继任者，对表现不佳的员工做出指导和决定；
·践行雅培核心诊断的价值观，建立一支高效致胜的销售团队。
跨部门合作
·通过内外部资源整合，确保跨部门合作项目执行到位，帮助解决客户问题。包括但不限于：
−具备成本分析，方案评估，费用控制等方面的知识储备，与财务部密切沟通；
−与市场部合作，支持产品发布，和所在区域的学术推广计划，组织和执行市场活动；
−与售后服务部合作，协调设备安装与维护，试剂性能验收等工作。

3.Requirement
·拥有卓越的销售和/或客户服务管理领导经验
·至少5年诊断行业经验，重点在于日常销售或服务管理、产品线拓展和盈利能力提升
·成功与客户（尤其是高级管理层和关键利益相关者）建立并维护良好关系
·具备医疗保健和诊断行业知识，包括：不断变化的市场动态、主要竞争对手、专业术语、挑战和法规
·优秀的销售和人际关系建立能力
·出色的沟通能力
·能够识别并推动问题解决
·着眼于客户的长期战略发展
·具有敏捷的市场洞察力
·具有较强的英语读写能力

jobs.title: District Sales Manager - Binh Duong
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
GIỚI THIỆU VỀ ABBOTT
Abbott là công ty chăm sóc sức khỏe toàn cầu, tiên phong trong nghiên cứu khoa học và tạo ra những đột phá trong công nghệ chăm sóc sức khỏe để giúp mọi người sống khỏe mạnh hơn. Chúng tôi luôn hướng tới tương lai, dự đoán và đáp ứng những thay đổi trong khoa học và công nghệ y khoa. Những công nghệ mang tính thay đổi cuộc sống của Abbott trải dài nhiều lĩnh vực từ dinh dưỡng, chẩn đoán đến thiết bị y tế và dược phẩm.

LÀM VIỆC TẠI ABBOTT
Tại Abbott, bạn có thể làm công việc tạo ra giá trị và ý nghĩa cho cộng đồng. Bạn được trao cơ hội để học hỏi và phát triển, chăm sóc bản thân và gia đình, đồng
thời thể hiện và phát huy tối đa tiềm năng của bản thân trong cả sự nghiệp và cuộc sống. Bạn sẽ có cơ hội:
- Phát triển sự nghiệp tại một công ty toàn cầu, nơi bạn có thể hiện thực hóa ước mơ nghề nghiệp của mình.
- Làm việc tại một môi trường được công nhận là “Nơi làm việc tốt nhất” tại nhiều quốc gia và được tạp chí Fortune (Mỹ) vinh danh là một trong những công ty được ngưỡng mộ nhất thế giới.
- Trở thành một phần của doanh nghiệp hàng đầu, được công nhận là nơi làm việc tốt nhất với môi trường tuyệt vời cho sự đa dạng và hòa nhập.

Địa điểm:  Bình Dương

MÔ TẢ CÔNG VIỆC
- Thúc đẩy kết quả trong vùng thông qua việc tạo lập và thực thi các kế hoạch tại địa bàn quản lý theo từng kênh và từng loại hình khách hàng
- Quản lý các nhà phân phối để bảo đảm các sản phẩm và dịch vụ luôn sẵn có ở mức tối ưu
- Đàm phám với nhà phân phối để tăng mức đầu tư vào vốn lưu động
- Cộng tác với các nhà phân phối với tư cách là đối tác kinh doanh, tác động để họ ủng hộ các kế hoạch/ưu tiên của Abbott

Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.
JOB DESCRIPTION:
MAIN PURPOSE OF ROLE
We are seeking a high caliber and ambitious Supply Chain Manager to join our team in Sylmar, CA . The Supply Chain Manager of Lifecycle Management will support the lifecycle of our product supply, including but not limited to New Product Introduction (NPI) and End of Life (EOL) product planning alignment.
The lead in this role supports new product development (NPD), product transfer, and engineering projects and is responsible for managing and executing all supply chain requirements and objectives to support overall business objectives.
This position provides an opportunity for key talent to develop toward future Supply Chain or Operations Leadership roles within the business. The role will have significant visibility to Senior Management and carries high expectations. This position will also have people leader responsibilities for highly skilled direct report(s).

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
- Manages supply chain program/product lifecycle management processes and execution for NPD and EOL.
- Engages planning teams to develop demand and supply plans during the new product development and EOL processes.
- Engages commodity managers and buyers during the design phase (early supplier involvement) and serves as a key participant in supplier selection for the program.
- Coordinates material purchasing schedules and inspection releases, working closely with cross-functional supply chain and supply quality groups. Assesses EOL and last-time-buy decision timeframes for leadership approval and alignment.
- Responsible for execution of all supply chain requirements and objectives of NPD, including total landed material cost analysis, lead time analysis, contingency planning, and risk mitigation.
- Ensures supply chain material master data in the ERP system is accurately updated before a product is released for commercial production.
- Represents the supply chain program management function while working with R&D, Operations, Engineering, and other departments as necessary during product development and launch planning processes.
- Provides key NPD and EOL program/product updates to Senior Management.
- Develops ramp-up and ramp-down schedules as products transfer from one site to another.
- Supports supply and demand discussions regarding new product and end-of-life demand assumptions.
- Identifies and manages process improvement projects that improve customer service levels, enhance product flow, minimize supply chain costs, and improve asset management.
- Partners with Engineering, Production, and Global teams on continuous improvement projects.
- Complies with U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations, other regulatory requirements, company policies, operating procedures, processes, and task assignments.
- Maintains positive and cooperative communication and collaboration with employees, customers, and suppliers at all levels.
- Provides input and consultation into annual long-range planning for new products and end-of-life assumption alignment with Commercial and R&D functions.
- Directly manages highly skilled direct report(s).
- Maintains a safe and professional work environment.

- Progressively more responsible materials management experience or experience in a related discipline.

- Multi-disciplinary knowledge with expertise in regulatory requirements for implantable cardiac devices.
- Familiarity with applicable FDA regulations, domestic and international regulatory submission requirements, and the ability to work within those constraints, as well as company operating procedures, policies, processes, and tasks.
- Supply chain or operations experience supporting new product launches, including functions such as demand and supply planning, procurement, supplier development, and manufacturing.
- Extensive experience managing cross-functional project teams.
- Skilled in delegation, follow-up, and team building.
- Ability to effectively communicate verbally, in writing, and through presentations across all organizational levels, including Senior Leadership.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, negotiation, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
- Demonstrated ability to deliver research and analysis that adds value to management decision-making.
- Advanced computer skills, including spreadsheets, word processing, database management, and specialized applications.
- Experience working within a broad enterprise or cross-divisional business model preferred.
- Ability to work in a highly matrixed and geographically diverse environment.
- Strong leadership skills, including the ability to set goals and provide positive and constructive feedback.
- Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, changing environment.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively at multiple organizational levels.

Join Abbott in a newly created Global Supply Chain Risk Manager role where you will help protect supply continuity, business performance, and brand reputation across a complex global network. As a key leader in Abbott's Supply Chain Resilience program, you will drive enterprise-wide risk identification, assessment, and mitigation strategies while partnering with stakeholders across procurement, operations, logistics, finance, quality, and executive leadership to strengthen supply chain resilience and ensure continued access to Abbott products worldwide.

What You'll Work On
- Lead and continuously enhance Abbott's enterprise-wide supply chain and supplier risk management strategy and resilience roadmap.

- Design, implement, and manage the Supply Chain Resilience (SCR) program, including governance, metrics, reporting, supply chain mapping, and associated tools.

- Leverage AI, predictive analytics, and risk intelligence capabilities to proactively identify potential supply chain disruptions and improve risk visibility.

- Monitor and assess supplier and third-party risks, including financial, operational, geopolitical, sustainability, logistics, business continuity, and single-source risks.

- Conduct risk assessments, scenario planning, and resilience analyses to prioritize risks based on likelihood, impact, and business criticality.

- Develop and drive mitigation strategies, including alternate sourcing, dual qualification, inventory optimization, and contractual risk controls.

- Partner with internal stakeholders across Procurement, Operations, Quality, Finance, ESG, Global Security, Government Affairs, Customs & Trade, and Logistics to embed risk management into business processes and sourcing decisions.

- Establish and facilitate governance through the Supply Chain Resilience Community of Practice to drive accountability and execution of mitigation actions.

- Collaborate with business teams to develop resilience metrics and scorecards that measure and improve supply chain resilience performance.

- Provide executive-level reporting, insights, and recommendations on emerging risks, trends, and mitigation progress.

- Support business leaders during supply disruptions by delivering data-driven analysis and strategic recommendations.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

- 7+ years of experience in supply chain, operations, procurement, logistics, or related disciplines.

- Experience identifying, assessing, and mitigating supply chain and supplier-related risks in a global environment.

- Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders without direct authority.

- Strong project management, organizational, and prioritization skills.

- Ability to work effectively across all levels of an organization, including executive leadership.

- Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.

- Advanced Excel skills and experience utilizing data to drive business decisions.

- Proven ability to navigate ambiguity and succeed in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

- Experience working across global teams and diverse cultures.

Preferred Qualifications
- Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration (MBA), or a related field.

- Experience leading enterprise-wide supply chain resilience, risk management, business continuity, or supplier risk programs.

- Knowledge of supplier risk frameworks, supply chain mapping, and resilience best practices.

- Experience managing supplier disruptions, crisis response, and escalation processes on a global scale.

- Proficiency with Power BI, ERP systems, and supply chain analytics tools.

- Experience leveraging AI-driven risk monitoring, predictive analytics, and machine learning capabilities.

- Strong understanding of geopolitical, sustainability, financial, and operational risk factors impacting global supply chains.

- Experience developing executive dashboards, metrics, and risk reporting frameworks.

jobs.title: Category Manager Procurement
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
About Abbott

At  Abbott,  we believe people live their fullest lives when they are healthy — physically, emotionally, and socially. As a  global healthcare leader with over 107,000 colleagues in 160+ countries , we create lifechanging technologies that support health at every stage of life.

Within our  Branded Generics business , we make trusted, high quality medicines accessible to more than  18 million people every day , particularly in fast growing regions such as LATAM, APAC, India, and Emerging Markets. Our diverse portfolio spans critical therapeutic areas including  Women’s Health, Gastroenterology, Cardiometabolic, CNS & Pain, and Respiratory  — addressing real, unmet patient needs worldwide.

Abbott is a place where  science, purpose, and people come together  — and where diverse perspectives are essential to building better outcomes for patients.

Primary Job Function:
- Responsible for Procurement, contracts, Negotiations, Supplier Relationship Management of all direct materials (API, Excipients) from EU.

- Lead and guide the team of procurement managers for developing category strategy, negotiating with vendors etc. to ensure that the strategic procurement objectives of PTO are met consistently.

- Managing a spend multimillion spend and over 100 global suppliers.

- Develop, Implement and Sustain the Procurement Management Strategy to fulfil growth as per LRP.

- Develop, drive supply market insight capability within the PTO to increase knowledge of supply market dynamics, composition, trends and gain a comprehensive understanding of the market landscape and business models from a macro and micro economic perspective covering Procurement.

- Monitor supply market dynamics across peer organizations also for benchmarking purposes.

- Use business insights to leverage opportunities. Ensure an effective communication process within PTO helping to create an informational advantage supporting strategic decision making.

- Responsible / Ownership for developing and implementing global supplier relationship strategies leveraging the informational advantage coming from the knowledge of supply market landscape and dynamics. Initiate, design and support to deliver specific strategic projects and initiatives considering all relevant financial, operational, qualitative and regulatory aspects.

The Opportunity
The Technical Category Manager, Plastics & Tooling is responsible for developing and executing global category strategies across plastic components, injection molding, tooling, and related manufacturing technologies. This role combines deep technical expertise in plastics engineering with strategic category management to deliver innovation, supply chain resiliency, quality, and total cost of ownership improvements across Abbott's businesses.
Serving as the primary link between Engineering, R&D, Operations, Supplier Quality, and Procurement, the Technical Category Manager translates technical requirements into scalable sourcing and manufacturing strategies. The role leads enterprise-wide tooling strategy implementation, supports new product introduction (NPI), assist in implementation of sustainability strategies and drives supplier-enabled innovation across plastic component categories.
As a recognized subject matter expert in plastics manufacturing and tooling technologies, this individual leads the Plastics Engineering Community of Practice from a Procurement lens and the Plastics Procurement team Community of Practice, fostering collaboration, capability development, and alignment between technical and commercial teams across Abbott.

What You'll Work On
- Develop and execute Abbott's global category strategy for plastic components, injection molding, tooling, resin technologies, and related manufacturing processes, managing approximately $800MM in spend
- Serve as Abbott's technical subject matter expert in plastics engineering, polymer materials, tooling, injection molding, and component manufacturing technologies.
- Lead supplier strategy including market assessments, supplier selection, commercial negotiations, contracting, performance management, and long-term partnership development.
- Develop and implement an enterprise-wide tooling strategy and roadmap focused on standardization, governance, asset lifecycle management, capacity planning, supply resiliency, and supplier capability development.
- Partner closely with Procurement, Engineering, R&D, Operations, Manufacturing, Supplier Quality, and strategic suppliers to align technical requirements with business objectives.
- Drive supplier innovation, Design for Manufacturability (DFM), early supplier engagement, and best-in-class manufacturing practices to support product commercialization and operational excellence.
- Support new product introduction (NPI) and product lifecycle initiatives by ensuring supplier readiness, tooling scalability, manufacturing capability, and supply continuity.
- Drive total cost of ownership improvements through resin optimization, component standardization, tooling efficiency, process enhancements, manufacturing productivity, and supply chain optimization.
- Conduct supplier capability assessments, manufacturing reviews, and benchmarking activities to inform sourcing, investment, and business decisions.
- Monitor and communicate emerging industry trends, materials, technologies, and supplier capabilities to identify opportunities for innovation, competitive advantage, and improved manufacturing performance.
- Lead cross-functional global initiatives and communities of practice that promote technical excellence, knowledge sharing, standardization, and best practices across Abbott divisions.
- Mentor procurement and engineering professionals and represent Abbott with industry associations, suppliers, technical conferences, and external forums to strengthen market leadership and manufacturing capabilities.

​ Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Plastics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Materials Engineering, Polymer Science, or a related technical discipline.
- 7+ years of experience in plastics engineering, injection molding, tooling, manufacturing, supplier management, procurement, or category management.
- Demonstrated understanding of injection molding processes, tool design and construction, tooling validation, and plastic component manufacturing.
- Strong understanding of polymer materials, manufacturing cost drivers, supplier processes, and tooling economics.
- Experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving engineering, operations, and procurement stakeholders.
- Proven ability to develop and execute strategic category plans that deliver measurable business results.
- Excellent communication, negotiation, influence, project management skills, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Polymer Engineering, Materials Science, Manufacturing, or Master’s in Business Administration (MBA).
- Professional certifications such as CPSM, CPM, PMP, or Six Sigma.
- Experience quoting contract manufacturing and plastic manufacturing process and equipment
- Experience in medical device, diagnostics, pharmaceutical, or other regulated manufacturing environments.
- Advanced knowledge of injection molding, blow molding, extrusion, automation, and mold-making technologies.
- Experience managing global tooling programs, mold transfers, supplier networks, and manufacturing capacity expansion initiatives.
- Familiarity with DFM methodologies, Moldflow analysis, and advanced manufacturing technologies.
- Demonstrated success leading communities of practice, technical councils, or enterprise capability-building initiatives.
- Deep knowledge of global plastics, resin, tooling, and manufacturing supply markets.

The position serves as the functional leader for Marketing and Sales Scientific activities in the region and is accountable for marketing strategy, product commercialization, key opinion leader engagement, scientific customer engagement, application excellence and business performance. - Oversee advisory boards, scientific exchange programs and KOL engagement initiatives.
- Ensure effective translation of clinical evidence, market insights and customer feedback into marketing and commercialization strategies.
- Drive customer engagement concepts, clinical education initiatives and scientific support activities that strengthen portfolio adoption and customer retention.
- Provide strategic oversight of customer training concepts, workflow initiatives and application excellence programs.
- Support tender strategies and clinical differentiation initiatives through strong understanding of customer pathways, workflows and unmet clinical needs.
- Responsible for the onboarding, training, coaching, and ongoing professional development of the commercial team.

Leadership & Organizational Development
- Lead, coach and develop Marketing and Sales Scientific team, fostering a high-performance and customer-focused culture.
- Provide disciplinary and functional leadership for direct reports.
- Set clear objectives, monitor performance and ensure alignment with business priorities.
- Support talent development, succession planning and organizational capability building.
- Promote collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement across the function.
- Build organizational capabilities that support current and future business objectives.

Business Performance & Cross-Functional Leadership
- Partner closely with Commercial Leadership to improve market penetration, customer engagement and business performance.
- Monitor and analyse key performance indicators, market performance and marketing effectiveness.
- Assume accountability for defined business performance indicators and functional objectives.
- Support pricing, profitability and commercial optimization initiatives.

- Remains current on developments in field(s) of expertise.

- Demonstrated market development skills.

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.
Our nutrition business develops science-based nutrition products for people of all ages, from helping babies and children grow, to keeping adult bodies strong and active. Millions of people around the world count on our leading brands – including Similac®, PediaSure®, Pedialyte®, Ensure® and Glucerna® – to help get the nutrients they need to live their healthiest life.

Working at Abbott
At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You will have access to:
• Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
• Benefits that support you and your family to stay healthy, financially secure, and supported throughout life's journey - including comprehensive medical insurance coverage, wellbeing support, and competitive rewards that recognize your contributions.
• A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.

The Opportunity
As the Compliance Manager , the Compliance Manager is responsible for managing plant compliance across the Site. The Compliance Manager is responsible for ensuring methods and procedures are appropriately followed; ensuring CAPA activities associated with global corrective actions and product improvement are followed through to completion; providing direction and leadership to plant staff and QEs for compliance-related issues and for key projects and business initiatives.

What You’ll Do
• Responsible for implementing and maintaining the effectiveness of the quality system.
• Assures all functional areas of the plant comply with all GMPs, required regulations and other practices outlined by customer or regulatory agencies.
• Serves as the key plant contact for all audits. Assures that the plant is well-prepared for the audit and manages all activities during the audit.
• Serves as the plant Safe Quality Food (SQF) Practitioner. The SQF Practitioner reviews and approves all plant document changes and validation changes for impact on the SQF system. The SQF Practitioner is responsible for developing and maintaining the plant HACCP program. The SQF Practitioner develops and executes the validation and verification activities for all plant prerequisite programs, control measures and critical limits.
• Provides continuous process improvement support for all key projects using the Business Excellence tools and techniques. Assures the projects and systems are lean and effective to maximize productivity.
• Reviews all complaint investigations and implements corrective actions, when necessary.

Requirements
Certification
• It is a requirement of your role that obtain and maintain certification as specified by Abbott.
Qualifications and Experience
• Bachelor’s degree in scientific or technical discipline OR an equivalent combination of education and work experience.
Competencies and Attributes
• Demonstrates strong judgment, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
• Communicates effectively (written and verbal) with strong interpersonal and consulting ability.
• Well-organized and tech-savvy.
• Excellent technical and regulatory local knowledge as it relates to the role.

This position is based in Pokeno, Waikato.

ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES
Summary:
Role: Sr. Business HR Specialist is the delivery of HR services across a major segment of the business. Business HR staff act as the face of the business to HR and the face of HR to the business. A key aspect of the role requires the Business HR staff to act as a liaison between the business and corporate HR. Business HR staff lend HR expertise to business strategy and consulting on a variety of HR functional issues.
- Breadth of Impact: Breadth of impact is focused on the specific business they serve. Decision-making can have impact across the HR functions within that business.
- Depth of Impact: Depth of impact is focused on HR issues within the business.
- Reporting directly to: Head of HR, EPD Vietnam
- High frequency of interaction: Senior management, Cross Function, Team and external Partners
- Working location: District 1, HCM city & Manufacturing site at VSIP (on business need basic only)

Core job responsibilities:
Business p artnering (70% of scope):
- Determine the requirements of the business by performing needs assessments to diagnose human capital issues.
- Act as a broker between the needs of the business and corporate HR by developing solutions that support the long-range objectives of both
- Establish, build and maintain strong relationships with key HR partners to ensure elements of HR are successfully coordinated to meet business needs
- Proactively identify and address changes in the business landscape that impact human capital issues
- Help the business make the right decision by balancing business strategy and people strategy
- Build the organizational talent pipeline by planning and contributing to key developmental experiences (e.g., leadership, cross-functional, technical, and global perspective)
- Ensure HR processes implemented in a full compliance with the legal and regulatory (internal & external) framework. Examples of HR processes include but not limit to HC plans and hiring, performance management, all employment life cycles; disciplines, etc.
- Support business to identify and monitor the organization culture so that it supports the attainment of the company goals and promotes employee satisfaction.

Recruitment (30% of scope):
- Coordinate with hiring managers to identify staffing needs, then define selection criteria
- Source potential candidates through multiple sourcing channels: online, offline, referral, …
- Facilitate full selection process, from screening, interviewing, assessments and offering.
- Foster long-term relationships with past applicants and potential candidates

Challenges
- Balancing the need for standardization in HR processes with the needs of an individual business or situation
- Navigating a highly matrixed organization
- Balancing unique requests from the business with limited HR functional expertise and resources
- Managing expectations of key stakeholders
- Being able to adapt with the fast growth and changes of business requirements

MINIMUM BACKGROUND/ EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

Work Experience :

Business Experience
- Experience working in a multinational company
- 5+ years of experience in multiorganizational HR support role

Business Experience recommended in detail:

Experiences (70%)
- Conduct job evaluations/classifications
- Consult through a organizational (re)design
- Participate in succession planning activities
- Form specific action plans based on analyzed data
- Work in a major workforce change (e.g., reduction in force, merger/acquisition, sales force realignment)
